proposed_widenings.name: resource_less_nonspell_activation
proposed_widenings.justification: The current non-spell activation family requires a resource and reset cadence, but this item is activated at will by spending only a Magic action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a Magic action and using the carpet's command word.

proposed_widenings.name: commanded_flying_item_platform
proposed_widenings.justification: The controlled thing is the item itself, which enters a persistent hover/fly state and obeys directions within a control radius. Existing shapes cover creature flight or commanded companions, not commanded item-platform motion.
proposed_widenings.evidence: It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.

proposed_widenings.name: load_dependent_item_speed_profile
proposed_widenings.justification: The carpet's speed depends on carried load, with one threshold for normal capacity and another for maximum carry capacity. Existing item shapes do not couple item load to movement speed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its Fly Speed is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity.

notes: The four carpet sizes fit the existing magic-item variant pattern, but the core mechanic does not fit any current authored family without lying. No Dhall/JSON/trace was produced.
